anomalies.detail: Whitespace, form-feed characters, zero-width characters, and obvious mixed-script confusables were normalized during ingestion.
Question 17 duplicated marker D in the source around `their ideas` and `talk`; canonical content was normalized to the expected marker sequence A-B-C-D.
Question 18 omitted the final marker on `decorate` in the source extraction; canonical render segments were normalized so `decorate` is marker D.
Embedded `Line` artifacts that leaked into passage line maps during text extraction were removed from canonical reading content.
Line-based reading prompts and referenced_lines were synchronized to the current canonical line maps after extraction cleanup.
Obvious prompt and choice artifacts such as missing initial letters, stray trailing words, and split words were normalized where the intended wording was clear from the source context.

note: Anomalies record source problems or deliberate normalization decisions. Canonical files should stay close to the DOCX while avoiding silent guessing.
